idea-plugin.name: Kassi Test Data
idea-plugin.description:
Kassi Test Data — valid banking & KYC test data, generated offline

Generate valid IBANs, test credit-card (PAN) numbers, BIC / SWIFT codes, VAT numbers, national IDs and coherent personas — right in your IDE, fully offline. A focused test-data generator for QA and fintech, not a generic faker.

Generic faker tools produce plausible-looking data. This plugin produces spec-valid data that actually passes a real validator — plus the deliberately invalid variant you need to test rejection paths. Built for QA and mobile/fintech engineers working on banking and KYC flows.

  • IBAN for the whole ISO 13616 registry — every European country plus 40+ worldwide (Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Israel, Brazil, Pakistan, Egypt and more): correct national length and a passing ISO 7064 mod-97 check, with an invalid-checksum variant.
  • Card (PAN) — Luhn-valid, from payment-gateway test BIN ranges only (never real issuable cards), with CVV and expiry, plus a Luhn-invalid variant.
  • BIC/SWIFT (ISO 9362), National IDs (NL BSN, DE Personalausweis, AU TFN, GB NINo, CY), and VAT / ABN tax identifiers — each with its real checksum.
  • Coherent personas — name, date of birth, address, bank and tax identifiers, all consistent for one person and country. Optional seed for reproducible fixtures.

100% offline and algorithmic. Zero network, zero scraping, zero real PII — everything is synthetic data for testing, not real identities. Every generator is covered by a unit test that asserts the valid output passes the real algorithm and the invalid variant fails it.

Free — and staying free. The generators in this plugin are free and will remain free; nothing here becomes paywalled. An optional extended fintech pack may arrive later as a separate paid add-on, but it will never lock away what you already use.

Usage: right-click in the editor (or Tools ▸ Insert Test Data), search, pick, and it inserts at the caret.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/KassiTestDataGeneratorPlugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.7.0

  • Worldwide IBAN: coverage now spans the full ISO 13616 registry — 40+ more countries beyond Europe (Türkiye, Israel, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Brazil, Pakistan, Egypt and many more), each with the correct national length and a passing mod-97, plus BIC and coherent personas. Lengths and BBAN layouts taken from the IBAN registry.

1.6.0

  • Italy — Codice Fiscale: full 16-character code with the real mod-26 control character. In a persona it encodes that person's name, date of birth and sex, so the Codice Fiscale is consistent with the rest of the identity.

1.5.0

  • More VAT: France (TVA — 2-digit key over a Luhn-valid SIREN) and Spain (CIF, type A — Sociedad Anónima), each with its real checksum and an invalid variant.

1.4.0

  • Nordic national IDs: Finland (HETU, mod-31 check character) and Norway (fødselsnummer, two mod-11 check digits) — both encode date of birth & sex, kept consistent with the persona.

1.3.0

  • More real, tested national IDs: France (NIR / INSEE), Belgium (National Register Number) and Sweden (personnummer) — each with its published checksum, and each encoding date of birth & sex so a persona's national ID stays consistent with its date of birth.

1.2.1

  • Internal: replaced a list-renderer API scheduled for removal with the stable base class. No functional changes.

1.2.0

  • More real, tested checksums: national IDs for Spain (DNI/NIE), Portugal (NIF) and Poland (PESEL — encodes date of birth & sex, kept consistent with the persona).
  • VAT for Poland (NIP), Italy (Partita IVA), Belgium and Portugal.
  • New LEI (Legal Entity Identifier, ISO 17442) generator for KYB/business data.

1.0.1

  • Internal: switched to the current (non-deprecated) list-renderer API for forward compatibility. No functional changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: IBAN, Card, BIC, National ID, Tax/VAT and coherent Persona generators.
  • IBAN, BIC, Card and Persona cover all European countries plus Australia; National ID and VAT ship real checksums for CY/DE/NL/GB/AU.
  • Valid and invalid variants for bank identifiers and cards. Optional seed for reproducible output.
